top_choice_rationale: P002 credits a defined molecule-making achievement: 3'-blocked, cleavable-fluorophore reversible-terminator nucleotides, a polymerase that accepts them and surface chemistry, which turned one quantitative incorporation-and-deblocking cycle into a routine, general readout with two decades of independent use. Balasubramanian and Klenerman conceived the scheme, and a citation anchored in the terminator chemistry keeps it chemical rather than a prize for genomics. Attribution (Ju, Mayer, Rothberg) is the main weakness. P001 is second on the strength of its validated mechanism, P003 adds a younger base-editing part I would not pair with sequencing, and P004 rests on a principle still contested in vivo.
